This constraint, rooted in how dynamics evolve, builds upon Werner Heisenberg’s original work on electromagnetic field quantization by focusing on fundamental limitations imposed by consistency itself. Consequently, full quantisation becomes necessary when linking already-quantum entities to gravity or electromagnetism, revealing deeper boundaries for physical theory.
